solver.method: Global SCP with graph-Laplacian soft targets, exact per-node source/trust/exit projections, all-face oriented-area guards, and sparse global face-pair separating-plane/wedge constraints projected as a third ADMM set; exact emitted-F32 surface self audit gates each accepted iterate

limitations: Construction geometry only. Frozen exit endpoints are rebased onto the current run024 candidate for rows classified inside by its complete point audit; one unmatched inside row and any >6mm remaining target are retained as unresolved. Pair barriers preserve local separating planes/wedges for three recurrent face pairs and dynamically add only exact witnessed pairs. A 15 nm RHS allowance plus any measured linear projection residual is permitted only while it remains below the smallest remaining pair margin; emitted-F32 exact self intersection must still be complete with zero pairs for every accepted step; they do not certify global self-disjointness, bone clearance, closed-solid containment, material reconstruction, or native acceptance.
